_meta.description: Patch document for the Sentinel n8n Package Router workflow. Apply these changes to enable Path E vegetation analysis triggers.
_meta.applies_to: n8n Package Router workflow that assigns processing templates to missions
_meta.instructions: In your n8n Package Router workflow, locate the template assignment switch node and apply these defaults. The vegetation_enabled flag controls whether Path E fires after Path C completes.

site_survey.rationale: Site surveys are the primary use case for vegetation analysis. Enabled by default.

environmental_survey.rationale: Environmental surveys require full vegetation inventory. Enabled by default with higher canopy limit and extended tier (includes interactive HTML map).

construction_hybrid.rationale: Construction monitoring focuses on structure progress, not vegetation. Disabled by default. Operator can toggle vegetation_analysis=true on the mission to enable.

real_estate.rationale: Real estate photography does not require vegetation analysis. Disabled by default.

routing_condition.description: n8n IF node to add at the end of Path C completion handler
routing_condition.on_true: Fire POST to /sentinel-vegetation-trigger webhook with { mission_id }
routing_condition.on_false: Continue standard delivery flow (no vegetation analysis)

supabase_query_for_routing.description: Supabase query to check both vegetation flag and Path C ortho completion

webhook_trigger.description: HTTP Request node to fire Path E trigger
webhook_trigger.note: N8N_BASE_URL should be your n8n instance URL (e.g. http://localhost:5678)

required_env_vars.N8N_BASE_URL: n8n instance URL for internal webhook calls (e.g. http://localhost:5678)
